item.title: New dog bar with 5,000-sq-ft park coming to site in east Ocala
item.description: A well-known restaurant group in Ocala has taken over a space that has been closed for several years and is in the midst of transforming it into a full-service dining and off-leash play experience for residents and their canine companions, promising a spot "where dogs are appreciated and humans are tolerated." Read more: New dog bar with 5,000-sq-ft park coming to site in east Ocala

item.title: Officials may rename Marion County operations center in honor of longest-serving sheriff
item.description: County officials are set to vote on a proposal to rename the Marion County Sheriff's Operations Complex in honor of the late Sheriff Don R. Moreland, a "law enforcement legend" credited with modernizing the agency and overseeing the construction of the facility itself. Read more: Officials may rename Marion County operations center in honor of longest-serving sheriff

item.title: Ocala police seeking $315,000 for Microsoft software, security tools for daily ops
item.description: The Ocala Police Department is seeking approval from city officials to spend $315,000 to maintain cloud software and security systems that underpin its daily operations and investigations. item.title: Barred owls living in Marion County backyard
item.description: This family of barred owls has lived in a reader's Marion County backyard for nearly 10 years. They come down from their tree early in the morning to bathe and let it be known whenever they need their bird bath filled, with their familiar hooting sound. Thanks to Tina Ramirez for sharing! Read more: Barred owls living in Marion County backyard
